fullPassage: When we think of leaders, we may think of people such as Abraham Lincoln or Martin Luther King, Jr. If you consider the historical importance and far-reaching influence of these individuals, leadership might seem like a noble and high goal. But like all of us, these people started out as students, workers, and citizens who possessed ideas about how some aspect of daily life could be improved on a larger scale. Through diligence and experience, they improved upon their ideas by sharing them with others, seeking their opinions and feedback and constantly looking for the best way to accomplish goals for a group. Thus we all have the potential to be leaders at school, in our communities, and at work, regardless of age or experience.

det.analysis: 본문 S3 'ideas about how some aspect of daily life could be improved'에서 위인들이 개선하려 한 것은 'daily life'(일상생활)의 어떤 측면이다.
det.tip: some aspect of daily life = 일상생활의 어떤 측면

questions.passage: These people started out as students, workers, and citizens who __________ (possess) ideas about how daily life could be improved. Through diligence and experience, they improved upon their ideas by sharing them with others, seeking their opinions and feedback and constantly looking for the best way to accomplish goals for a group.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 과거시제 동사 possessed
det.analysis: 주절의 동사 started out이 과거시제이고 관계절도 같은 과거의 사실을 서술하므로 과거시제 possessed가 적절. possess → possessed
det.tip: who possessed ideas = 생각을 지녔던 (과거시제)

questions.passage: When we think of leaders, we may think of people such as Abraham Lincoln or Martin Luther King, Jr. If you consider the historical importance and far-reaching influence of these individuals, leadership might seem like a noble and high goal. But like all of us, these people started out as students, workers, and citizens who possessed ideas about how some aspect of daily life could be improved on a larger scale. Through diligence and experience, they improved upon their ideas by sharing them with others, seeking their opinions and feedback and constantly looking for the best way to accomplish goals for a group. Thus we all have the potential to be leaders at school, in our communities, and at work, regardless of age or experience.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 본문은 누구나 리더가 될 수 있다는 가능성을 설명
det.analysis:
❌ ① 위인들의 생애: 위인은 예시일 뿐 생애가 주제가 아님

❌ ② 아이디어 보호: 본문은 아이디어 공유를 강조 — 반대

✅ ③ 누구나 리더가 될 가능성: 본문은 위인들도 평범하게 시작했고 누구나 리더가 될 잠재력이 있음을 설명 ← 정답

❌ ④ 승진 전략: 본문은 승진 전략이 아님
det.tip: we all have the potential to be leaders = 우리 모두 리더가 될 잠재력이 있다

ch: 역사 속 위대한 지도자들의 생애와 업적
누구나 리더가 될 수 있다는 가능성

questions.passage: When we think of leaders, we may think of people such as Abraham Lincoln or Martin Luther King, Jr. If you consider the historical importance and far-reaching influence of these individuals, leadership might seem like a noble and high goal. But like all of us, these people started out as students, workers, and citizens who possessed ideas about how some aspect of daily life could be improved on a larger scale. Through diligence and experience, they improved upon their ideas by sharing them with others, seeking their opinions and feedback and constantly looking for the best way to accomplish goals for a group. Thus we all have the potential to be leaders at school, in our communities, and at work, regardless of age or experience.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 나이나 경험에 관계없이 누구나 리더가 될 잠재력이 있다는 것이 요지
det.analysis:
❌ ① 타고난 소수만: 본문은 누구나 가능하다고 함 — 반대

❌ ② 혼자만의 노력: 본문은 타인과의 공유·협력을 강조 — 반대

❌ ③ 나이 많을수록: 본문 'regardless of age'(나이 무관) — 반대

✅ ④ 누구나 리더 잠재력: 본문의 핵심 결론과 일치 ← 정답
det.tip: the potential to be leaders ... regardless of age or experience

ch: 리더십은 타고난 소수의 사람만이 지닌 것이다.
위대한 업적은 오직 혼자만의 노력으로 이루어진다.
나이가 많을수록 더 훌륭한 리더가 될 수 있다.
나이나 경험에 관계없이 누구나 리더가 될 잠재력이 있다.

But like all of us, these people started out as students, workers, and citizens who possessed ideas about how some aspect of daily life could be improved on a larger scale. Through diligence and experience, they improved upon their ideas by sharing them with others, seeking their opinions and feedback and constantly looking for the best way to accomplish goals for a group. Thus __________ at school, in our communities, and at work, regardless of age or experience.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 빈칸에 들어갈 영어를 쓰시오.
우리는 모두 리더가 될 잠재력을 가지고 있다
[조건] (1) all, be, have, leaders, potential, the, to, we를 모두 사용할 것 (2) 정확히 8단어로 쓸 것 (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: we all have the potential to be leaders = 우리는 모두 리더가 될 잠재력을 가지고 있다
det.analysis: 빈칸은 'Thus __________ at school, in our communities, and at work' 구조. 주어(we all) + 동사(have) + 목적어(the potential) + to부정사(to be leaders) 구조. the potential to V = ~할 잠재력. 8단어.
det.tip: have the potential to be ~ = ~이 될 잠재력을 가지다
